metrics.odor_identity: virtual low-dose food-odor surrogate; not measured cow odor
metrics.odor_source: moving cow position, hidden from controller
metrics.plume: deterministic downwind Gaussian with meander and intermittency; wind=(-1,0) in world XY
metrics.sensor: bilateral virtual antennae, +/-0.12 m in body lateral axis
metrics.neural_input: ORN_DM1 and ORN_VA2 on each side; 0.08*concentration extra voltage per 20 ms tick; no connectome weight changes
metrics.readout: same bearing-trained DNa02 readout, not odor-trained

conditions.tag: tag bearing and image-size speed rule; odor withheld
conditions.tag_odor: same visual inputs plus bilateral ORN stimulus
conditions.odor_only: no tag bearing injected and fixed forward speed; conventional quad stabilizer remains

tag_1.control_roles: neural/geometric yaw; image-based rule: forward speed; stabilizer: four motor thrusts

tag_odor_1.control_roles: neural/geometric yaw; image-based rule: forward speed; stabilizer: four motor thrusts

odor_only_1.control_roles: neural/geometric yaw; image-based rule: forward speed; stabilizer: four motor thrusts
